Protests surrounding the CJP have taken a violent turn, resulting in clashes and an attack on law enforcement personnel.

During the intensifying demonstrations, agitators resorted to heavy stone pelting, directly targeting security forces deployed on the ground to maintain order. At least one policeman has been severely injured in the attack and has been rushed for medical attention. Additional security forces have been mobilized to bring the situation under control.
